faqs.a: Multiply length x width x height in feet. A 3 x 3 x 3 ft box holds 27 cubic feet — which is also exactly 1 cubic yard.
faqs.q: How do I calculate cubic feet?

faqs.a: Divide cubic feet by 27. There are 27 cubic feet in one cubic yard (3 x 3 x 3).
faqs.q: How do I convert cubic feet to cubic yards?

faqs.a: One US gallon = 231 cubic inches, so one cubic foot holds 7.48052 gallons. Multiply your cubic feet by 7.48052.
faqs.q: How many gallons are in a cubic foot?

faqs.a: One cubic meter = 35.3147 cubic feet. To convert the other way, multiply cubic feet by 0.0283168.
faqs.q: How do I convert cubic feet to cubic meters?

faqs.a: Use inches mode and enter all three dimensions in inches: the tool converts internally. Or divide each inch dimension by 12 to get feet first.
faqs.q: My measurements are in inches. What now?

cubic-feet-calculator.formula:
cubic feet = length x width x height (all in feet)
cubic yards = cubic feet / 27
cubic meters = cubic feet x 0.0283168
gallons (US) = cubic feet x 7.48052
liters = cubic feet x 28.3168

cubic-feet-calculator.workedExample:
A raised bed 3 x 3 x 3 ft:

1. Cubic feet = 3 x 3 x 3 = 27.
2. Cubic yards = 27 / 27 = 1.
3. Cubic meters = 27 x 0.0283168 = 0.76.
4. Gallons = 27 x 7.48052 = 201.97.
5. Liters = 27 x 28.3168 = 764.55.

One cubic yard of soil fills it — or about 202 gallons of water.
